title: Settle
description: Release some of what your body is carrying. Choose the amount of time you have.
quick_steps: Feel both feet making contact with the floor.
Lift your shoulders gently. Let them drop as you breathe out.
Unclench your jaw and soften the space between your eyebrows.
Let one exhale run a little longer. Nothing else needs doing right now.
full_steps: Find a position where you don't have to hold yourself up. Let your shoulders drop.
Notice your feet on the ground. Press them down gently, then let go.
Clench your hands into fists for a moment. Then release, and feel the difference.
Roll your shoulders up toward your ears. Hold. Then let them fall.
Unclench your jaw. Let your tongue rest away from the roof of your mouth.
Soften your forehead and the space between your eyebrows.
Take one slow breath. Let the exhale be a little longer, without forcing it.
Notice you're still here, still breathing. That's enough for right now.
complete_line_one: You gave your body a little less to hold.
